about: Raids an enemy village and, if reach_hours is above 0, then the other enemy villages within that many hours of its own march of it, keeping away from forces above a set strength that could reach it within avoid_hours.
calls_back: a large army comes near the raiders, or there is nothing left to raid

reach_hours: after the first village, raid the others within this many hours of the lord's own march of it; 0 raids only the first
avoid_ratio: pull back into the nearest friendly castle or town when the forces that could reach it within avoid_hours are this many times its strength (enemy lords, armies and bandits in view, and armies seen there in the last 6 hours)
avoid_hours: how near counts for that: within this many hours of the lord's own march

when.poke: Forces too strong came near {me}'s raid on {target} (strength {threat_near(me, pace * avoid_hours)} against {strength}); pulling back.

when.if: reach_hours > 0 and next_village(at, pace * reach_hours) != none

when.poke: {me} has nothing left to raid around {at}.

away.about: pulling back from the raid on {target}

when.if: hours_in_state >= 6 and threat_near(me, pace * avoid_hours * 1.5) < strength * avoid_ratio
